annotations.title: Check a specific list of domains

description: Check availability for a specific list of full domains (e.g. ['acme.com','acme.ai']). Returns availability, renewal details where supplied, and a registrar link. This fast lookup does not supply a registration quote; use search_domain for prices. Up to 25 domains per call.

domains.description: Full domain names to check, each including its extension (e.g. ['getacme.com','acme.ai']). Up to 25 at a time.

name: check_availability
title: Check a specific list of domains
